description: This PHP source file defines a class 'StudentT' that provides statistical distribution functions related to Student's T distribution, including probability calculations and inverse functions.

classes.name: StudentT
classes.description: A class providing methods for calculating Student's T distribution probability and its inverse.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the probability for Student's T distribution based on value, degrees of freedom, and number of tails.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the Student's T distribution (one-tailed probability).

methods.name: calculateDistribution
methods.description: Private method translating a Pascal algorithm to compute the Student's T distribution probability.
